turns.question: What are the opening hours of the Rijksmuseum in Amsterdam?
turns.shown:
The Rijksmuseum is open every day from 9:00 am to 5:00 pm. That includes today, Saturday, and public holidays.

- **Official hours:** The museum's own page says it opens every day of the year from 9am to 5pm, including all public holidays. [1]
- **Booking:** You have to book a start time. This applies to everyone, including Museumkaart holders. [2] The museum recommends buying tickets online in advance. A limited number are sold at the entrance while stocks last. [1] Once you're inside, you can stay as long as you like until closing. [1]
- **Shop and café:** They're open 9 am to 6 pm. Between 5 and 6 pm you can go in without a museum ticket. [1]
- **Gardens:** The museum says the gardens are open only in summer, from 9 to 18h. [1] They may therefore be closed now, in late October. That is my inference from the season, and I didn't find a page that confirms the garden's status today.
- **Restaurant:** RIJKS restaurant serves lunch Wednesday to Sunday and dinner Tuesday to Sunday. [1]

**Last entry:** I found no last-entry time on the official pages. Third-party sites disagree: one says 4:30 PM [3] and another says 4 p.m. [4] Aim to arrive well before 4 pm.

**Late openings:** One unofficial guide mentions Friday late openings. The official pages I found don't mention them, so I wouldn't count on them.

**Currency:** The official pages carry no date stamp. Before you go, check the museum's "Opening hours and prices" page for any one-off closures or changes today.

Sources
[1] Opening hours and prices - Rijksmuseum — https://www.rijksmuseum.nl/en/visit/practical-info/opening-hours-and-prices
[2] Visit the Rijksmuseum - Rijksmuseum — https://www.rijksmuseum.nl/en/visit (search result age: 5107 days ago)
[3] Visit The Rijksmuseum: Museum Tips And Highlights — https://www.getyourguide.com/explorer/amsterdam-ttd36/visit-rijksmuseum/ (search result age: 123 days ago)
[4] RIJKSMUSEUM: ticket prices 2026 - queues - opening hours — https://www.travelguide.amsterdam/en/museum-amsterdam/rijksmuseum/tickets-queue/ (search result age: 246 days ago)

# Admissions and opening hours
We open our doors for you every day of the year from 9am to 5pm, including all public holidays.
** Booking a start time is required for a visit to the Rijksmuseum. This applies to everyone, including Museumkaart holders.
- We recommend buying your tickets in advance online to ensure entry at the desired time. A limited number of tickets are also available at the museum...
- Once inside you can stay as long as you want during opening hours.

## Shop, café and gardens
The Shop and The Café are open from 9 am to 6 pm.
Between 5 and 6 pm you can enter without an entrance ticket.
The green gardens around the museum are only open during summer. Opening hours are from 9 to 18h.
RIJKS restaurant is open on Wednesday to Sunday for lunch and on Tuesday to Sunday for dinner.
The last entry is generally at 4:30 PM, with the museum’s shop and café open from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
